# v1.12.5 — My Team rename and duplicate-push hardening

## Product name

- Renamed the user-facing product from SolRay to **My Team** across the web title and mobile onboarding/login fallbacks, notification titles, Android launcher label, and notification channel text.
- Push titles now use the instance’s configured app name rather than a hard-coded product name.
- Kept the GitHub repository, Android application ID, Dart/package identifiers, and updater repository coordinates unchanged so existing installs, signatures, Firebase configuration, and updates remain compatible.

## Duplicate notification fixes

- Added a backend collapse guard that suppresses repeated pushes for the same task and text within 90 seconds, covering create-then-save double fires and retries.
- Fixed a mobile background-isolate path that could display a second local notification for the same FCM notification already displayed by Android. The backend no longer duplicates the notification title in data, and the background handler skips the notification-block copy.
- Made launcher icons build reproducibly from committed source artwork through `flutter_launcher_icons`.

## Verification

- `py_compile`, Docker Compose configuration, Flutter analysis, and all 17 Flutter tests passed with Flutter 3.24.3.
- Mobile package version: **1.12.5+18**.
